page.overview:
Who is Amado Delsin?

Amado Delsin was a pirate from Lankiveil.

Amado Delsin was born on Lankiveil, where he later became a pirate. He wielded dual sabers, with which he claimed to have killed over 200 men. He was rumored to have plundered entire fleets single-handedly and had affairs with noblewomen across the Imperium. He was captured by the forces of Abulurd Rabban and taken to Giedi Prime, where he was placed in the slave pens.

Delsin was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, Poyko Nen, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition begans, he fought his way through a pack of swamp vipers. He crossed paths with Tom and a fierce showdown occured between them, which ended with Delsin slicing Tom open and causing his guts to spill out. He then encountered the twins, with the sister being injured from falling from the Serpent Spire. He attacked the brother, but the sister had faked her injuries and attacked Delsin from behind. The twins outmanouvered and killed Delsin.
